slots.hair: shoulder-length and blow-dried under at the ends, with a wine-red clip-in piece being put in
slots.outfit: a white shirt done up to only the second button, a black pencil skirt, black stockings and heels not yet taken off
slots.place: at the dressing table in her old Tainan apartment after the broadcast, her suit jacket already hung on the back of the door
slots.action: She is sitting at the dressing table clipping the wine-red hair piece in, the jacket already hung up behind her.
slots.face: She is watching herself in the mirror with a small smile that only she knows the reason for.
slots.light: The dressing-table lamp is the only light in the room, coming from one side in front of her, everything else black, the framing deliberately off-centre.

slots.hair: shoulder-length, pushed behind one ear by the wind
slots.outfit: a dark green silk slip with a cream light jacket over her shoulders, not put on properly
slots.place: up on the roof of her old apartment building at night, a washing line still strung across and the low Tainan rooftops beyond
slots.action: She has sat down against the base of the water tank with one hand pushing her hair behind her ear.
slots.face: The expression she makes in the half-second before she starts a sentence, her eyes reaching the lens first.
slots.light: One old lamp on the roof sits to the side in front of her and the night sky and rooftops are completely dark.

slots.hair: shoulder-length and slightly flattened from sleeping, the clip-in piece gone
slots.outfit: a cream cotton robe thrown on and tied anyhow
slots.place: in the bathroom of her old apartment, the tiles old and the edge of the mirror rusted
slots.action: Her free hand has just taken the clip-in hair piece out and is setting it down on the counter.
slots.face: Just woken, none of the broadcast voice in her face, no expression at all.
slots.light: The lamp above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom goes dark.

slots.outfit: a black fine-strap camisole, holding a wine-red dress up in front of herself
slots.place: in front of the open wardrobe in her old apartment, a whole rail of clothes she only wears on camera, mostly dark
slots.action: She is standing at the open wardrobe holding a wine-red dress up against herself with one hand.
slots.face: Completely deadpan, the way she says very ordinary things in a news-anchor voice.
slots.light: A small light inside the wardrobe throws up at her from the front and low, the rest of the room dark.

slots.hair: shoulder-length with the anchor's blow-dried inward curl, no clip-in piece
slots.outfit: a broadcast suit jacket over a white shirt buttoned all the way to the top
slots.place: at the news desk in the local station's studio after the broadcast has ended, the desk light still on and the rest of the studio switched off
slots.action: She is still sitting behind the desk with the scripts already put away, unclipping the microphone with one hand.
slots.face: Crisply articulate, sitting straight, her eyes directly on the lens.
slots.light: The lamp over the news desk is still on and the rest of the studio is black, the framing clean and symmetrical.
